report.question: 经典验证者怎样借助 LWE 与两种测量基，检验量子性并约束单个高效量子证明者的计算结果？

4F01.scope: 量子寄存器、计算基、Born 概率、有限集合编码与酉变换的定义。

4F02.scope: 迹一半正定密度矩阵、混合表示、投影概率与归一化；I/2 修正。

4F03.scope: 部分测量条件态、合法支撑分解及平方范数扰动界。

4F04.scope: Hadamard 张量积的二进制 Fourier 展开与单比特概率。

4F05.scope: Pauli 反交换、带正确次序的 H 共轭、迹正交展开。

4F06.scope: 可逆求值、反算辅助位及模线性 Gaussian 态的正确归一化；Gaussian 振幅的高效制备作为额外输入。

4F07.scope: PPT、一致 QPT、BQP/BPP、安全参数及参数依赖量子建议模型。

4F08.scope: 可忽略函数和计算不可区分的量词，公共高效后处理与多项式混合。

4F09.scope: 有限分布平方 Hellinger、全变差比较与平方根振幅距离；全变差定义独立复用 4F27。

4F0A.scope: 模整数中心代表、截断 Gaussian 及乘积立方支撑。

4F0B.scope: 明确 n,m,q、秘密分布、误差族及攻击模型的判定 LWE；不混同搜索或二进制秘密归约。

4F0C.scope: 素数域随机矩阵列秩失败概率 <q^(n-m)，由逐行均匀和并集界证明。

4F0D.scope: 给定有理数域可逆整数 T，且 ||Te||inf<q/2 时精确恢复；不构造陷门生成器。

4F0E.scope: 四个 XOR 条件的矛盾和随机策略的凸平均，经典胜率恰为 3/4。

4F0F.scope: 有限维二值投影 CHSH 的 Tsirelson 上界和 Bell 态达到；不证明鲁棒刚性。

4F10.scope: 单射 A 的无噪声两支理想目标态及公开 y 的均匀分布；未声称任意有限门集精确制备奇数支撑均匀态。

4F11.scope: 归一化后态范数差平方等于 h²；理想支撑不交时的条件两支态与整体实验误差。

4F12.scope: 任意二进制编码两支态的 Hadamard 奇偶约束，掩码均匀性及 ceil(log2 q)。

4F13.scope: NTCF 结构条件保留精确 f/f' 分布；平方根态是理想目标。有限门实现要求对控制、输出、工作寄存器及任意纠缠辅助空间统一可忽略范数误差，理想工作寄存器为零；实现误差进入后续测量损失。

4F14.scope: 好掩码与正确/错误无条件质量差的完整自适应量词。

4F15.scope: BCMVV Theorem 4.1 的 A.1–A.4 参数和量子建议 LWE 模型；§4.3 (23)–(26)、脚注 3 的有限精度 Gaussian 制备与精确分布公式分开。陷门和自适应归约仍是外部输入。

4F16.scope: 抽象两挑战协议；诚实 μ_c 同时计入 f/f' 误差与有限门相干制备误差；对每个固定经典证明者存在 μ_P，配置复制提取得到 3/4+μ_P。精确 f' 目标的测试轮概率一与实际实现的 1-negl 区分。

4F17.scope: 零掩码以及 x0=2、非零末两位 11 的坏掩码反例。

4F18.scope: 已知一端的 r·s 化简、偶模数最低位等式、奇模数回绕反例；任意编码的奇轨道定理及其证明独立置于 4F2C。

4F19.scope: 独立种子有限域线性剩余哈希引理的碰撞概率与 Schwarz 推导。

4F1A.scope: 条件于随机行核的高熵 S 使 CS 恒为零，显示独立种子不可删除。

4F1B.scope: 均匀秘密判定 LWE 的逐列混合，随机位置归约及 δ/n 优势。

4F1C.scope: 固定非零奇偶位的条件熵 n-1 及联合全变差界；不声称自适应泄漏定理。

4F1D.scope: 任意 α0,α1 的爪编码 Hadamard 解码振幅计算。

4F1E.scope: 辅助向量系数、偏迹密度矩阵、秘密控制反算和解码概率。

4F1F.scope: 独立均匀相位平均消去交叉项；对角 Kraus 归一化、测量等价与 Z 概率保持。

4F20.scope: 逐支证明原像寄存器相位回踢到逻辑比特，保留全局相位。

4F21.scope: Lemma 6.12 按 §7.2 的条件输出重述；一个态对全部基，pH+sqrt(pT)+μ；§6 深安全归约外引。

4F22.scope: 传播项非负平方和、历史态归一化、零能核与固定输入；不证明局部化与能隙。

4F23.scope: XZ 抽样接受概率逐项证明；2-local XZ 电路归约作为所引 §7.1 的外部输入。

4F24.scope: 保留 ICM 摘要及 §4 援引的量子 LWE 经典验证定理作为外部研究输入。另列 v3 抽象 extended-TCF 协议定理与精确旧构造不匹配。明确采用抵抗参数依赖多项式量子建议的 LWE 假设，并要求抽象函数族的自适应硬核、单射不变性和固定掩码条件在同一建议模型下安全。完备性 μ_c 独立陈述；先固定攻击电路及建议态族，再取对所有长度 λ 输入统一的 μ_P。任意坏输入序列 x_λ 可作为独立于新密钥的经典建议。奇轨道障碍引用 4F2C；不添加回绕边界条件，不声称重建具体 LWE 实现。

4F25.scope: 报告提出的单证明者无密码假设问题；区分无界与 QPT 恶意模型，不宣称已解决。

4F26.scope: 陷门单射族与公钥模式不可区分；理想平方根态与有限门的联合态可忽略误差分开，引用 4F13 的控制/工作/辅助系统误差约定。

4F27.scope: 有限全变差、事件最大差、有界测试函数、随机处理收缩与共同边缘分解；独立中性基础页。

4F28.scope: 共同酉变换及投影测量的全变差 ≤ 向量范数差；有限自适应实验的相干标签扩张。

4F29.scope: 原 v3 固定掩码定义完整量词，常值攻击者对双值集合的限制；引用 4F2C 奇轨道证明说明奇模数全定义域平移实现与该定义不匹配，改变编码或自适应好掩码不修复它。

4F2A.scope: Protocol 5.1 基预选、密钥模式、承诺、轮次与解码；有限门相干制备在任意纠缠输入下每次误差 ε，N 次调用至多 Nε，计入可忽略完备性损失。

4F2B.scope: 否实例 M≤sI 的纠缠输入指数矩与 KL 尾界；是实例使用独立 M_yes 和诚实乘积态，a<c<1 时给有限散度公式，c=1 时单列失败概率零。

4F2C.scope: 对任意奇整数 q≥3、n,w≥1、s∈(Z/qZ)^n、任意编码 J 和掩码 d，完整证明平移轨道长度整除 q，二进制导数不能沿奇轨道恒一，故全定义域值集合恒含零。常值零预测者的结论只适用于该平移模型，不否定一般 Mahadev 验证定理。

remaining_branches.branch: Robust CHSH rigidity and multi-prover verification
remaining_branches.scope: 4F0E–4F0F prove the finite-dimensional optimal winning probabilities. Robust self-testing, RUV rigidity and sequential multi-prover protocols are report context, not proved or imported as local theorems.

4F15 cites the precise NTCF construction contract. Efficient lattice trapdoor generation, coherent Gaussian sampling, binary-secret reductions, boundary-sensitive noise estimates and adaptive leakage resilience are not reconstructed.
4F21 uses the abstract extended-family theorem with one state for all bases. Its computational twirl, auxiliary-space reductions and multi-qubit hybrid security proof remain external.

ICM quantum-LWE classical verification remains an attributed primary research input. The old v3 fixed-mask definition and odd-q full-domain translation implementation conflict: 4F2C proves every fixed mask, for any encoding, has zero in its value set by odd-cycle parity. No encoding-only repair or extra boundary-condition premise is supplied; the corrected concrete instantiation was not reconstructed. This does not disprove the general verification theorem.

remaining_branches.branch: Local Hamiltonian reduction and unconditional verification
remaining_branches.scope: The circuit-to-2-local-XZ reduction and spectral-gap proof are external inputs. 4F25 records the report's open single-prover question without asserting a later resolution.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: TrapGen Theorem 2.6, coherent finite-precision Gaussian preparation and the full Theorem 4.1/§4.4 adaptive-hardcore reduction are external inputs. §4.3 (23)–(26) and footnote 3 were additionally read during repair; exact ideal amplitudes are not asserted to be finite-gate outputs.

Lemma 6.12/Claims 6.13–6.14, §6 binding and Protocol 7.5/Theorem 7.6 abstract soundness optimization remain cited. Negligible soundness is quantified per fixed efficient adversary; local twirl/kickback proofs do not replace these reductions. In 4F24 the advised security convention is explicit: fixed circuit and advice family precede the negligible bound, and all input sequences are covered by allowing classical advice independent of fresh keys.

§7.1 circuit-to-2-local XZ Hamiltonian promise reduction, attributed there to Biamonte–Love and Morimae–Fitzsimons. Those primary papers were not retrieved here. Local history-state and sampling calculations prove only their explicitly narrower statements.

The exact v3 Definition 4.4 / §8.4 full-domain fixed-mask realization remains unresolved in this packet. Re-checked current arXiv history still lists v3; targeted primary-source searches found no verified newer repair. ICM classical verification under LWE is retained as an attributed result, independently of this incomplete reconstruction. No invented wraparound hypothesis is attached to that theorem.

metadata.model_conventions: Finite-dimensional registers; second-variable-linear complex inner product; normalized density matrices; prime q only for field-rank/hash/construction claims, general modulus where explicitly stated; ceil(log2 q) binary encoding; finite full variation uses one-half L1; PPT/QPT and parameter-dependent quantum advice distinguished; noisy completeness 1-negl. Finite-gate preparation has negligible joint control/output/workspace/reference error relative to clean ideal states. Soundness negligible functions are adversary-dependent; completeness uses a separate function. Honest repetition uses a separate yes-instance operator and treats c=1 separately. For 4F24, advice-resistant LWE and compatible advised primitive security are explicit operative assumptions, not optional variants: each fixed circuit/advice family has its own negligible bound uniform over all inputs of length lambda. Arbitrary input sequences are polynomial classical advice independent of fresh keys.
metadata.coverage: All mathematical branches of report §§1–5 and Appendix A represented; elementary local derivations versus exact cited research inputs distinguished.
metadata.shared_integration: Parent-owned; no shared landing, registry, workflow, theme or existing tree edited; no commit/push or full-site build.

source_clarifications.resolution: Publisher report DOI/PDF is authoritative. Distinct arXiv supplements are pinned to v4 and v3, not presented as an arXiv edition of the report.

Truncated coordinate product distributions have cube support, not a Euclidean-ball truncation. 4F11 assumes an explicit Hellinger bound and proves its consequence; a truncation-boundary-free Gaussian shift proof is not imported.

4F0D requires T invertible over Q, TA=0 modulo q, and strict ||Te||inf<q/2; entry bounds require m tau E<q/2. Generation close to uniform is an external theorem, not exact uniformity of a generated key.
Known endpoint allows an x-dependent derived mask r, which may vanish for nonzero d. Fixed-mask leftover hashing is not substituted for adaptive leakage resilience.

4F21 follows §7.2 restatement and Claim 6.13 using acceptance-conditioned D^C, whereas the first printed Lemma 6.12 statement omits superscript C. One rho works for all bases; postselection error is stated quantitatively.
h is fixed before key generation. The later random challenge chooses test versus Hadamard round, not an arbitrary late basis for a fixed key.

Ideal algebra has exact equalities. Finite-gate preparation approximates the complete control/output/workspace/reference state relative to ideal clean workspace by a negligible norm error; multiple polynomial calls accumulate negligible error. Completeness uses mu_c; for each fixed efficient adversary P soundness uses its own mu_P. In 4F24 the advice family is explicitly part of P, and both LWE hardness and abstract primitive security cover parameter-dependent polynomial quantum advice, including classical advice for arbitrary input sequences.

source_clarifications.location: F01: LWE theorem versus old construction
source_clarifications.resolution: 4F24 explicitly attributes classical verification under quantum LWE to the ICM abstract/§4. The abstract extended-TCF theorem is stated separately. 4F18 supplies the endpoint calculation and lowest-bit counterexample; the independent arbitrary-encoding obstruction is 4F2C. Neither supplies sufficient boundary conditions for a repaired implementation or a disproof of the general theorem.

source_clarifications.location: F03: exact ideals and coherent finite-gate implementation
source_clarifications.resolution: 4F13 defines one joint norm approximation for all control superpositions, including arbitrary reference entanglement and ideal zero workspace. 4F15/4F16/4F26/4F2A propagate this convention; exact f' target support acceptance is not mistaken for exact acceptance of a compiled state.

source_clarifications.location: F04: distinct yes/no tests and c=1
source_clarifications.resolution: 4F2B uses M<=sI only for no instances. Honest yes instances use M_yes and rho_yes; the displayed finite divergence is restricted to a<c<1, while c=1 gives zero lower-tail failure directly.

source_clarifications.location: F02 rereview: all input sequences and advice
source_clarifications.resolution: 4F24 explicitly assumes LWE hardness against every fixed QPT circuit with any polynomial-size parameter-dependent quantum advice family. The abstract adaptive-hardcore, injective-invariance and fixed-mask conditions are required against the same advised class. A worst-case x_lambda is polynomial classical advice independent of fresh keys, so the stated per-P negligible bound is uniform over all inputs of that length.

4F2C is a new standalone theorem with q,n,w,G,s,J,d,g,orbit and value-set hypotheses introduced locally. 4F18 retains only endpoint linearization and its immediate modular example; 4F00/4F24/4F29 link to 4F2C for the general obstruction. No existing ID or title changed.

source_errata.issue: A is m×n with m>n, yet the text says full row-rank.
source_errata.resolution: 4F0C uses full column rank. Its probabilistic proof explicitly assumes prime q, so Z_q is a field; no field-rank statement is silently made for composite q.

source_errata.issue: H Z^z X^x H is printed as Z^x X^z without the ordering phase.
source_errata.resolution: 4F05 gives X^z Z^x = (-1)^(xz) Z^x X^z and proves the matrix identity.

source_errata.issue: Uniform sums over q^n inputs lack the q^(-n/2) normalization.
source_errata.resolution: 4F06 and 4F11 retain the uniform normalization; conditional and whole-experiment errors are separated.

source_errata.issue: Without a good-mask condition, d=0 wins trivially; merely requiring d nonzero is still insufficient.
source_errata.resolution: 4F17 gives both counterexamples. 4F14 and 4F16 use the full good-set and adaptive-hardcore conditions from BCMVV Definition 3.1.

source_errata.issue: Displayed expression duplicates the z summation in the Pauli-average calculation.
source_errata.resolution: 4F1F derives the single-qubit twirl independently, summing each Pauli index once and proving trace preservation.

source_errata.issue: The lowest binary bit of x XOR (x-s mod q) is asserted to equal binary s without a wraparound qualification.
source_errata.resolution: 4F18 proves the lowest-bit counterexample; 4F2C independently proves the arbitrary-encoding odd-cycle obstruction on the entire Z_q^n translation domain. The even-q identity is only an algebraic observation, not a repaired prime-q instantiation or a new assumption for the general verification theorem.

source_errata.issue: Definition 4.4 takes H' over all claws. For odd q and full-domain x1=x0-s, any function g(x)=d.J(x) has an odd translation orbit on which g(x)+g(x-s) cannot be identically 1. Thus 0 belongs to H' for every secret and fixed mask, so the constant-zero algorithm wins with probability one. This is stronger than a lowest-bit typo and is not fixed merely by another encoding or adaptive good masks.
source_errata.resolution: 4F2C proves the obstruction; 4F29 records the exact old-v3 definition/implementation mismatch. 4F24 retains classical verification under LWE as an attributed ICM research input, separately gives the abstract extended-family theorem, and supplies no invented boundary condition or reconstructed concrete instantiation. No verified newer repair was located in the scoped primary-source checks; the general Mahadev theorem is not claimed false.
